name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue "Chieftain Chicken" Skewer with Sweet Polynesian Glaze
whyItWorks: Boneless, skinless chicken breast cubes grilled on a wooden skewer with a sweet Polynesian barbecue glaze. Lean, unbreaded, and packed with bioavailable protein.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chieftain Chicken Skewer with a side of white rice or Tiger Tail breadstick.
watchOuts: None; premier park snack for high-protein sustenance
